Lily: Quick, fun one — a 30‑second weird talent show. What can you do in under 30s that's useless but impressive? I'll go first: I can fold a paper airplane that actually loops once midair. gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/loop-plane-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA

Jamal: I can name the capital of any US state in 3 seconds. Try me :)

Maria: I can hum the opening of at least 10 video game themes on demand. :video_game: sometimes my brain is a jukebox

Kevin: I can balance a mug on my head and walk three steps without spilling coffee. (not recommending testing in the office) :coffee:

Sofia: I can tie a cherry stem into a knot using only my tongue. gross + impressive? :sweat_smile:

Devon: I can type "sudo" faster than anyone in this channel. not sure that counts as a talent though 😅

Lily: @Sofia that is peak party trick honestly. Jamal — do it, what state?

Jamal: Alaska

Maria: Wait, Montana? (testing Jamal)

Jamal: Nope, Alaska. :v:  (you win the internet for 2 seconds)

Kevin: New one: I can make an echo by clapping in the stairwell and it sounds like a tiny drumline. anyone else have acoustic flexes?

Sofia: Devon, your sudo speed is terrifyingly useful during standups. OpsBot, please log that as a non-critical skill.

OpsBot: Recorded: "Devon - rapid sudo typing" added to #random-hall-of-fame. :robot_face:

Maria: Okay serious quick poll: who wants an IRL 30s talent hour at the next in-person meetup? thumbs or nah

Lily: :thumbsup: count me in. we can call it "Microskills" and have tiny trophies

Jamal: :thumbsup:

Kevin: :thumbsdown: only if snacks are involved

Sofia: :thumbsup: but I demand a judge who gives out comedic commentary

Devon: :thumbsup: i'll bring a stopwatch and my terminal speed demo

Lily: Love it — I'll put a tiny note in the meetup thread. thanks for playing, this brightened my afternoon :)
